titles: game.input press on a paused game loses the pressed edge
input.pressed never fires after game.input while paused
game.input frames argument does not step the game
fixes.note: A press injected while paused waits for the next simulated frame; game.input takes frames.

titles: Render-target cameras have no culling mask
fixes.note: Camera.showTags / Camera.hideTags choose what a camera draws by entity tags.
